message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the correct crime(s) for this case. Facts: Wu obtained contract for construction without public bidding, gave bribes to officials (cash) to get the contract. This is bribery (giving bribes to state staff). The crime is "受贿" (accepting bribes) vs "行贿". The defendant is the one giving bribes, i.e., "行贿" (bribery). In Chinese criminal law, "行贿罪" is the crime of giving bribes to state functionaries. The description: "为谋取不正当利益，给予国家工作人员以财物" => that is "行贿罪". So the correct label: "行贿". The examples: earlier they had "受贿" for state staff receiving bribes. For giving bribes, they used "受贿" for the recipient, "行贿" for the giver. In the case, Wu is the giver. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法经营" but not. So single charge.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
